content.text:
=== leaflet library in web/libraries ===
leaflet-control-geocoder
leaflet.fullscreen
leaflet.gesture-handling
leaflet.markercluster
=== leaflet module ===
web/modules/contrib/leaflet/leaflet.info.yml
=== leaflet views display in locations ===
        type: leaflet_map
        options:
          grouping: {  }
          data_source:
            field_address_location: field_address_location
          entity_source: field_address_data
          entity_source_submit: 'Update Entity Source'
          name_field: ''
          leaflet_tooltip:
            value: ''
            options: '{"permanent":false,"direction":"center"}'
          leaflet_popup:
            value: title
            view_mode: address_block
            options: '{"maxWidth":"300","minWidth":"50","autoPan":true}'
          leaflet_map: 'OSM Mapnik'
          height: '400'
          height_unit: px
          hide_empty_map: false
          disable_wheel: true
          gesture_handling: true
          reset_map:
            control: true
            options: '{"position":"topleft","title":"Reset View"}'
          map_scale:
            control: false
            options: '{"position":"bottomright","maxWidth":100,"metric":true,"imperial":false,"updateWhenIdle":false}'
          locate:
            control: false
            options: '{"position":"topright","setView":"untilPanOrZoom","returnToPrevBounds":true,"keepCurrentZoomLevel":true,"strings":{"title":"Locate my position"}}'
            automatic: false
          map_position:
            force: false
            center:
              lat: 52.52
=== is there an OSM/geocoder field widget on location ===
22:    - field.field.node.location.field_osm_id
229:        - field_osm_id
420:  field_osm_id:

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== leaflet library in web/libraries ==="; ls web/libraries/ | grep -i leaflet; echo "=== leaflet module ==="; ls web/modules/contrib/leaflet/*.info.yml 2>/dev/null; echo "=== leaflet views display in locations ==="; sed -n '686,720p' config/sync/views.view.locations.yml; echo "=== is there an OSM/geocoder field widget on location ==="; grep -rn "field_osm_id" config/sync/core.entity_form_display.node.location.default.yml 2>/dev/null | head
